outcome: low Apgar scores at first and fifth minutes after birth
cohort: The study included 210 singleton pregnant women from the obstetrics and gynaecology department of MMCH, Madhubani, Bihar, divided into 105 cases with any adverse birth outcome and 105 controls with none.
finding: Maternal age >35 years, pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH), previous caesarian section (CS), and premature rupture of membrane (PROM) were significant determinants of adverse birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Previous caesarian section was identified as a significant risk factor for preterm labour.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from July 2023 to June 2024.
